sentences.text: 7. I find merit in the argument of learned counsel for applicants that there are attending circumstances which may be a ground for lodging a criminal complaint as within a few days of lodging of FIR at the behest of Applicant-1 present complaint was filed.

8. On merit also, I am of the considered opinion that Trial Court has summoned applicants under difference offences and for such minute classification there must be an analysis and reasoning, may be in brief.
However, as referred above in operative part of impugned order no such reasoning has been assigned.

The Trial Court has also not noted that complainant has not disclosed date of occurrence as well as on one hand offence was committed by members of unlawful assembly but simultaneously applicants were summoned on individual act also.
9.
In view of above, application is allowed in part.

Impugned summoning order dated 22.01.2024 passed by Judicial Magistrate 1st, Bareilly in Complaint Case No. 1776 of 2023 (Imran Ahmad Khan vs. Faheem and others), under Sections 452, 323, 379, 147 IPC, Police Station Shahi, District Bareilly, is hereby quashed.
